item.title: MSNBC’s Joe Scarborough: RealClearPolitics Predicted A Tie; “Nobody Else Came Close”
item.description: MSNBC’s Joe Scarborough credited RealClearPolitics as being one of the few election predictions that even came close to forseeing the Trump landslide. RCP elections analyst Sean Trende predicted in June that Donald Trump could win the election by turning out the “missing” white voters that didn’t show up for Mitt Romney.
